messages:
zoe-cs: Customer reported a sudden spike in embeddings "usage" yesterday — invoiced 3x expected. They say dashboard shows "vectors" but billing shows tokens + vectors. Invoice & request id attached: req_abc123
sarah-support: Thanks Zoe. Can you paste a minimal request payload we can repro with? Also which dashboard chart they're looking at?
zoe-cs: They shared this curl and a screenshot of /console/usage -> embeddings (vectors). Sample request:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1","input":"hello world"}'
```
They say request_id in app logs = req_abc123. Screenshot shows 3 units counted for that call.
ben-eng: I'm looking at our events stream. For req_abc123 I see two events within ~200ms: frontend.event (type=request_sent) and ingest.event (type=embedding_completed). Both have unit_count=3 in payload. Looks like both are aggregated into the same dashboard metric which sums unit_count across event types -> double counting when both emit units.
aj-ops: Do we have a unique request_id across both producers? If yes, we should dedupe in the aggregation step by (request_id, metric_type).
tim-telemetry: Query I ran to repro:
```
SELECT request_id, event_type, SUM(unit_count) AS total_units
FROM telemetry.events
WHERE request_id = 'req_abc123'
GROUP BY request_id, event_type;
```
Result: frontend:3, ingest:3, dashboard sum = 6. That's the 2x.
ben-eng: Root cause: legacy frontend instrumentation increments unit_count for estimated vectors at request start; the embedding worker also emits the authoritative vector_count after compute. We never migrated the dashboard aggregators to prefer the authoritative event, so both are being summed.
sarah-support: Customer-facing ask: how quickly can we remove the frontend estimate from the metrics or move it to a 'estimated' series so billing charts only show authoritative counts?
aj-ops: Hotfix plan: 1) Update aggregator to dedupe by request_id preferring event with event_status='completed'. 2) Backfill: run a nightly job to re-calc daily aggregates for last 7 days to fix shown spikes. 3) Expose a QA flag to hide estimated counts. I can roll the aggregator change to staging now.
ben-eng: I'll push a change to the instrumentation to stop emitting unit_count on the frontend for embeddings. That prevents future duplication if aggregator lag exists.
billing-bot: Notice: A billing adjustment request has been created for invoice INV-9087 (requested by zoe-cs). Status: pending_review.
zoe-cs: I'll update the customer: tell them we're aware, rolling a fix, and we'll reconcile their invoice if the root-cause confirms double-count. Apologies :disappointed:
sarah-support: Thanks team. Please post the staging link and the aggregator PR when ready so I can validate against the customer's sample. Also add the repro SQL to the internal incident doc.
ben-eng: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/telemetry/+/1234 (agg change). Staging aggregations look good, dedupe applied. Patch scheduled to production in 30m with canary.
aj-ops: Canary looks clean, no perf regression. Backfill job queued: run time ~2h for last 7 days.
tim-telemetry: Added the repro query and sample payload to the incident doc: /docs/incidents/embeddings-usage-attrib-1769998888
sarah-support: Great. Zoe — will follow up with customer after production deploy + backfill. Marking thread resolved once invoice updated.
zoe-cs: will do. :+1:
